    Small PlatesRed Dragon casino prawnsCrisp fried prawns tossed in a wok with garlic, red chilli and spring onionHow to make it500g shell-on green prawns1 pinch white pepper60g potato starch1 L vegetable oil, for frying4 garlic cloves1 red chilli2 spring onionssalt, to tasteDry the prawns well, season with salt and white pepper and toss in the potato starch.Fry in 190°C oil in batches until crisp.In a wok, fry the sliced garlic, chilli and spring onions in a little oil, then add the prawns and toss well.SupperRicky Tan's Hong Kong roast gooseDuck for goose: five spice, dried overnight and roasted, plum sauce and jasmine riceHow to make it2kg whole duck2 tsp Chinese five spice1 tsp salt2 tbsp honey1 tbsp hot water150ml plum sauce2 cups of jasmine riceRub the cavity with five spice and salt, then leave uncovered in the fridge overnight to dry the skin.Brush with honey loosened with hot water.Roast at 180°C, brushing again twice.Rest the duck, cook the rice and chop through the bone.Serve with plum sauce and rice.Caesars Palace winnings prime rib plateGarlic and herb crusted beef roasted pink, red wine gravy, horseradish, roast potatoes and cornHow to make itNot on tonight's cookGarlic and herb-crusted beef rib roasted pink and carved thick, with red wine gravy, creamy horseradish, crispy roast potatoes and buttery corn.Rub a 1.5kg boneless beef rib roast with 3 crushed garlic cloves, chopped rosemary, olive oil, salt and pepper.Roast at 220°C for 20 minutes, then 160°C for about 50 minutes until 54°C inside.Rest 20 minutes.Roast 1kg halved potatoes in oil at 220°C for 45 minutes.Make gravy from the pan juices with 1 tbsp flour, 150ml red wine and 300ml beef stock.Boil 4 corn cobs 6 minutes and butter.Serve with horseradish cream.After the ShowMango sagoPaid in Reign's superdollars. They burn red.How to make it80g sago pearls3 mangoes200ml coconut milk100ml evaporated milk1/2 pomeloBoil the sago in plenty of water until clear.Rinse under cold water and chill.Blend the flesh of two mangoes with the coconut milk and evaporated milk.Fold in the sago and divide into bowls.Top with diced mango from the third mango and pomelo segments.Hong Kong egg tartsSmall bites. Hu Li tapes a grenade in Lee's mouth.How to make it70g caster sugar120ml hot water3 eggs80ml evaporated milk40ml full cream milk2 sheets of puff pastryDissolve the sugar in the hot water and cool.Whisk in the eggs and both milks, then strain.Cut rounds from the pastry and press into a greased patty tin.Fill the cases three quarters full.Bake at 200°C until the custard is just set with a slight wobble.From the BarHong Kong milk teaFor the party on Ricky Tan's yacht.How to make it4 tbsp loose black tea800ml water200ml evaporated milk4 tsp caster sugarSimmer the tea in the water.Strain twice through a fine cloth or sieve.Add the evaporated milk and sugar and stir. Serve hot or over ice.
